description: This file is a shell script used for testing functionalities related to git-p4 symlinked directories, including setting up a Perforce server, creating directories and symlinks, and performing git and Perforce operations.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a local Perforce server instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Perforce command to add files to the depot.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the workspace with the depot.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting successful completion of commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test case.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.
